You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

You should watch less television, as too much TV makes you stupid in the long run, like your brother. It would be an exception if you only watched quiz shows, but you tend to watch Big Brother and X-Diaries.
What argument components exists in sentence "You should watch less television, as too much TV makes you stupid in the long run, like your brother" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>You should watch less television,</pro> <pro>as too much TV makes you stupid in the long run,</pro> <pro>like your brother</pro>
